description: What the app's own pages may ask of the shell once the main window has left the splash for http://127.0.0.1:<port>: opening a web, mailto or tel link in the system's default handler, and nothing else. The opener plugin intercepts every click on a link that opens a new tab (an external link in the in-app docs, 'Open the still' on the Captures card) and hands it to open_url; the shell's capabilities covered only the local splash, so the request was refused after the click was already gone and every such link was dead in the desktop app. The two origins are the ones pin_capability grants the capture commands to; the port is a wildcard because the shell picks a free one at launch (an omitted port would mean the default port only). The shell's own commands, the capture commands and the file opener stay where they are: default.json for the splash, capture.rs at run time for the one port the backend runs on.
